== Summary ==
Identified: [[Jacy Smith]] (teal t-shirt and full beard; same face as [[:File:2021 World Championship Slack 11 October.jpg]] and the standing man in [[:File:2022 Endor Grand Prix 21.jpg]]). Remaining faces unlabeled: player in glasses, an orange tee, and a grey jacket; player in a light plaid shirt with a red cup; player in a black New Era cap.
The [[2022 Endor Grand Prix]] in Seattle, Washington (8–10 April 2022).
